title: Regular completed coefficients and the quotient Koszul fiber
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $O$ and uniformizer $\pi$, and a scheme $T$. On $T_{\mathrm{proét}}$ put $R=\mathcal O_{E,T}$ and $B_n=(O/\ell^n)_T$ for $n\geq1$, with their projections and quotient transitions [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. Use cochain derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and total tensor complexes [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There are a unit $u\in O^\times$ and $e\geq1$ with $\ell=u\pi^e$; the two sequences of ideals are cofinal. The rings $O/\pi^j$ and $O/\ell^n$ are finite for all $j,n\geq1$. The canonical maps identify $R/\ell^nR=B_n$ and $R/\pi^jR=(O/\pi^j)_T$. Multiplication by every $\ell^m$ and $\pi^j$ is injective on $R$. The augmented two-term complexes $K_m=[R\xrightarrow{\ell^m}R]\to B_m$ and $L_j=[R\xrightarrow{\pi^j}R]\to(O/\pi^j)_T$, in degrees $[-1,0]$, are finite free K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex].

For $n\geq m\geq1$ set $P_{n,m}=B_n\otimes_RK_m=[B_n\xrightarrow{\ell^m}B_n]$, with augmentation $\epsilon_{n,m}:P_{n,m}\to B_m$ given by reduction in degree zero, and $F_{n,m}=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon_{n,m})[-1]$. The map $B_m[1]\to F_{n,m}$ with degree $-1$ coordinate $x\mapsto\ell^{n-m}x$ in $P_{n,m}^{-1}$ (and zero other coordinates) is a quasi-isomorphism of $B_n$-complexes. In particular $H^{-1}(P_{n,m})=\ell^{n-m}B_n\cong B_m$ and $H^0(P_{n,m})=B_m$. For $n'\geq n\geq m$, the coefficient reduction $F_{n',m}\to F_{n,m}$ corresponds under these quasi-isomorphisms to multiplication by $\ell^{n'-n}$ on $B_m[1]$. These statements include $n=m$.
